messages:
Priya: Noticed a small spike in fncall schema rejects after the 03:00 rollout. Error sample: `SchemaMismatch: response.items expected object but got []`
Ethan: That was the strict-validate flag for canary-gamma, right? I thought sampling stayed 1%...
Zoe: We intended 1% but the sampling key was accidentally set to 100% in the rollout patch.
SRE-Bot: deploy/canary-gamma applied at 03:02 (build 2026.03.13-03:01).
Priya: Impact: ~0.25% of traffic in eu-west, traced rejects doubled and storage spiked because we capture full payloads.
Ethan: Quick plan: 1) revert sampling to 1%, 2) change router to permissive-coerce with fallback to legacy for prod routes, 3) throttle full payload capture to sampled 1/500 and cap 64KB.
Zoe: I'll implement telemetry changes: emit `fncall.rejects` with tags (route_id, variant), `fncall.coerce` and enable an example-sampler (1/1000) with PII scrubber.
Observability: Scrubber rules suggested: redact emails, mask numbers >8 digits, drop fields matching /ssn|dob/i. We'll keep hashed session_id.
Ethan: I'll open rollback PR now: "revert/strict-sampling-canary-gamma" and tag @Zoe for instrumentation review.
SRE-Bot: incident INC-2026-099 created P2 assigned to Priya, Ethan, Zoe.
Priya: After rollback: sampling back to 1%, rejects dropped to 0.01%, coerced_count ~0.12%. Dashboard now shows scrubbed examples.
Zoe: Filed TASK-520 for the model adapter to fix output shape. Also adding a rollout checklist entry: sampling, fallback, telemetry, scrubber, billing rule.
Ethan: Good catch. Let's keep strict testing limited to internal-only variants until instrumentation and fallback are proven.
Priya: Closing loop: add timeline and metrics to the incident, owners for follow-ups.
